title: Irreducibility of Random {0,1} Polynomials
exact_target: Is a uniformly random binary-coefficient polynomial with constant coefficient one irreducible with probability tending to one as its degree grows?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 146 (GREEN-058). CC BY 4.0.

Lior Bary-Soroker, Dimitris Koukoulopoulos and Gady Kozma, \emph{Irreducibility of random polynomials: general measures}, arXiv:2007.14567v3 (2023), §1, discussion of binary coefficients and Theorem 1 with coefficient set $\{0,1\}$.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, maintained author list, Problem 93 and its comments, accessed 7 October 2026.
